tagline: Aromatic Herbal Depth for Global Kitchens
overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies premium dehydrated thyme leaves processed from selected thyme herbs in India. We clean, sort, and gently dehydrate the leaves to retain their authentic earthy aroma and herbal flavour profile. This process ensures moisture stays below 8 percent. The result is a consistent ingredient ready for seamless integration into diverse commercial food processing lines.

As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we manage production through an organized six-step process. Our dehydrated thyme leaves offer extended stability and easy storage compared to fresh herbs. We provide comprehensive export documentation support, custom mesh sizing, and private label services to serve international distributors, institutional kitchens, and industrial food manufacturing businesses worldwide.
highlights: 8 to 16 mesh cut size for uniform dispersion

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated thyme leaves?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, supporting both trial batches and regular bulk industrial orders.

faqs.q: Can you provide custom cut sizes or mesh specifications?
faqs.a: Yes, our standard cut is 8 to 16 mesh, and we adjust grinding and sieving parameters to meet custom mesh requirements.

faqs.q: What processing stages do the thyme leaves go through?
faqs.a: We follow a 6-step process including sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch.

faqs.q: Do you provide product samples prior to bulk orders?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide samples upon request along with product technical data sheets to assist with formulation testing.

faqs.q: What packaging options do you offer for export?
faqs.a: We pack in 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and small private-label retail pouches or jars.

faqs.q: What export and compliance support does TradeNest Naturals provide?
faqs.a: We are an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter providing complete export documentation support and batch traceability for international shipments.
